paragraphs: Before departure, inspect seat belts and seats and verify attendance. During the trip, look back through the mirror and remind children who are roughhousing to sit safely. At each stop, extend a hand to help them exit, then count again. During an emergency, first calm the bus and contact the driver. After the route, organize the roster and anomaly records and prepare for the next day's route.

In short: help every child leave the bus safely. Duties include attendance, safety supervision, discipline management, boarding and exiting assistance, emergency response, and recordkeeping. Using both observation and communication, school bus monitors safeguard students' commutes.

subject.name: School Bus Monitors
subject.summary: School bus monitors are the final helping hands that ensure every child exits safely. Counting students, watching safety, managing discipline, and assisting with boarding and exiting all culminate in the reminder, 'We're here; take your time.'
